label: CNIL — Google LLC + Google Ireland (€90M + €60M, cookie banners)
body: Holding: €150M total (€90M Google LLC + €60M Google Ireland) for cookie-banner design that placed an "Accept All" button on the first layer but required navigating through several clicks to refuse. Refusing must be as easy as accepting. Deceptive design infringed French Loi Informatique et Libertés Art. 82 (transposing ePrivacy Art. 5(3)).

Why it matters: Established the "reject as easy as accept" enforcement standard. Preceded by CNIL's Amazon €35M decision (7 Dec 2020 — advertising cookies set without any consent, not reject/accept asymmetry); followed by Microsoft €60M and TikTok €5M (both Dec 2022), which applied the reject-symmetry standard. EDPB Cookie Banner Taskforce report (Jan 2023) endorses this as the EEA-wide standard. (The separate Délibération SAN-2021-024 of the same date is the Facebook Ireland €60M cookie decision.)
